tei:div.tei:p: (475)mkha' 'gro gsang ba kun 'dus kyi 'don 'grigs rgyud byang bltas chog tu bkod pa bzhugs// (476)

na mo gu ru mañdzu gho ṣa ye/ de la 'dir skal ldan gyi gang zag dbang lung man ngag thob cing gnas dus yo byad phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan pas rdo rje phag mo sgrub cing mchod pa'i skabs su 'don 'grigs phyag len gyi tshul/ 'jam mgon bla ma'i zhal slob rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po dbang lung man ngag du mas rjes su bzung ba'i bka' drin can dge ba'i bshes gnyen dam pa blo gros bzang po nas ji ltar bstsal ba rang blor gang nges gzhung gi dgongs pa dang yang bstun nas 'bri ba la/ thog mar rang lugs chos spyod rgyas bsdus ci rigs sngon du btang nas/ tshig bdun gsol 'debs/ le'u bdun ma tshang ba'am mi lcogs na le'u gang rung re'i mthar/ brgyud 'debs/ gdod nas rnam dag rang byung gsang ba'i dbyings/ /sogs/ de nas rdo rje phag mo'i phrin las kyi dbu nas/ tshogs zhing rtsa gsum rgyal ba rab 'byams kyi dkyil 'khor nam mkha' gang bar sad par gyur/ na moḥ bdag dang khams gsum 'gro ba kun= sogs/ skyabs 'gro dang*/ bdag gis sems can thams cad rnams= sogs sems bskyed dang*/ ho: bla ma mkha' 'gro'i lha tshogs dgongs/ sogs/ sdom bzung rnams so sor lan gsum re/ de rnams las skyabs 'gro la thog mar tshar gcig 'don rta dang*/ de nas tshar gnyis pa man thams cad lhug 'don dal bus mdzad/ de mtshams rdo rje slob dpon mdun las bum bzhag nas/ swa bhā wa sa sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las las kyi bum pa mtshan nyid phun sum tshogs pa'i dbus su las byed kyi mkha' 'gro ma karmā dhā ki (477)ni gsal ba'i sku las dag byed bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pas bum pa gang bar gyur/ ces pa'i dmigs pa dang las bum la rdo rje rtse gcig pa'i phyag rgyas reg bzhin tu/ oṃ sa karmā dhā ki ni hūm̐ phaṭa: brgya rtsa'am nyer gcig tsam gyi mthar/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ lha 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i bum pa'i chu nus pa dang ldan par gyur/

ces brjod/ de nas sngon gtor dkar bgegs spyi 'gros ltar la/ oṃ baṃ badzra bhā ra hi kro dhī ka lī ha ri ni sa āḥbe sha ya: bdag nyid rdo rje khros ma nag mo'i skur gyur/ oṃ sa karmā dhā ki ni hūm̐ phaṭa: kyis bsang*/ swa bhā wa sa sbyang*/ stong pa'ingang las bhrūm̐ las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du gtor ma kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs par gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ho: lan gsum gyis brlab/ bhu mi pa ti sa pā ri wā ra badzra sa mā dza: sa spyan drangs/ bhu mi pa ti sa pā ri wā ra na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bhyo= sogs nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags rgya lan gsum gyis bsngo/ gang dag 'dir gnas= sogs dang*/ mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la= sogs mthar rol mo bcas/ de nas bgegs gtor/ raṃ yaṃ khaṃ gis bsangs/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hoḥ sa brlab/ oṃ sarba bhu ta a karṣa ya dzaḥ sa dgug oṃ sarba (478)bighāṃ ba lingta khā hi sa bsngo/ de nas rol mo'i zil 'bebs sum rdeg sogs gang rigs dang*/ hūm̐ hūm̐: nga ni phag mo khros ma ste: gul yungs brab bdug rol mo bcas bgegs bskrad/ hūm̐ hūm̐: stong gsum stong gi 'jig rten na: sogs kyis mtshams bcad/ de nas rim bzhin rgyun gyi rnal 'byor la/ 'gal rkyen sdig sgrib sbyong ba/ āḥ bdag gi spyi bor pad zla'i steng: sogs gsal gdab/ oṃ:bla ma dpal ldan rdo rje sems: sogs nas/ nad gdon sdig ltung thams cad lhag med du sbyang par gyur/ ces brjod cing yig brgya nyer gcig tsam bzlas pa'i mthar/ sdig sgrib dag pa'i gnang ba byin nas rdo rje sems dpa'i yab yum rang nyid la thim par gyur/ ces brjod/ de nas tshogs bsags ni/ mdun gyi nam mkhar tshogs zhing bla ma rdo rje phag mo skyabs gnas kun 'dus su gsal btab pa'i spyan sngar rang gzhan sems can thams cad sgo gsum gus pas 'khod par gyur/ ces dang*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐:

ri rab gling bzhi mu khyud bcas= sogs dang*/ phyi snod bcud kyi 'byor pa/ nang rang lus phung khams/ gsang ba dbyings rig dbyer med maṇḍal gyi tshul du phul bas bla ma skyabs gnas kun 'dus kyis dgyes pa chen pos bdag gir mdzad/ rang gzhan sems can thams cad sku gsum zhing khams rgya (479)mtsho la longs spyod pa'i sa bon thebs/ mthar tshogs zhing rnams rang gzhan sems can thams cad la thim par gyur/ ces dang*/ de nas byin rlabs ye shes 'bebs pa la/ rten skyed pa/ hūm̐: rang lus der 'dzin med pa'i ngang: sogs kyis gsal btab la/ rang gzhan sems can thams cad kyis kha tsam min pa'i mos gus gdung shugs drag pos yan lag bdun pa 'bul zhing gsol ba 'debs par gyur/ zhes dang*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐: skyabs gnas kun 'dus o rgyan bla ma la: sogs kyis yan lag bdun pa 'bul zhing*/ e ma ho: ngo bo blo 'das 'od gsal chos kyi sku= sogs lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab la/ thod phreng rtsal kyang phreng skor gcig tsam bzlas mtshams/ rdo rje phag mo'i phrin las bshags pa bya ba/ hūm̐: dgongs shig bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro'i tshogs= sogs dang yig brgya tshar gcig dam bca' ba/ oṃ:dus gsum rig 'dzin mkha' 'gro'i gdung 'tshob phyir= sogs nas/ sa ma yāḥ.āḥ yan bton rjes/ rim gnyis rgyun gyi rnal 'byor nang gi dbang blang ba ni/ mkha' khyab sku gsum dbyer med rdo rje 'chang= sogs nas/ rdo rje khros ma nag mo'i sku ru gyur: zhes pa'i bar ro/ 'gal rkyen sdig sgrib sbyong ba nas bzung 'di yan lhug 'don dal brel ran pa tsam las 'don rta dbyangs sogs med/ de nas phag mo'i phrin las/ byin chen dbab pa/ rang gi snying ga nas (480)chen po'i 'od zer= sogs nas/ sa ma yaḥst+waṃ/ bar/ dai nas spos dang rol mo rkang gling thod rnga sogs/ gdangs dbyangs ji ltar rigs pa bcas/ hūm̐ hūm̐: phyogs bcu dus bzhi'i zhings khams nas:

sogs/ e a ralli hriṃ hriṃ pheṃ pheṃ: zil 'bebs bzhag rol mthar rnga rol bzhag nas/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho:da nga*/ nam mkha' gang ba'i lha tshogs thams cad bdag gnas yo byad rnams la thim pas sku gsung thugs mi zad pa rgyan gyi 'khor lor byin gyis brlabs par gyur/ zhes brjod do/ de nas mchod rdzas byin gyis rlob pa ni/ hūm̐: gnas khang dur khrod chen po'i gzhal med khang : sogs lhug 'don dang*/ pū dza āḥhūm̐: bar mchod rol dang*/ hūm̐: rlung me thod pa'i sgyed pu= sogs tshig bcad rnams lhug 'don dang sngags rnams lan gsum re'i mthar/ mchod pa'i sprin rab 'byams kyis nam mkha'i khams thams cad gang bar gyur/ zhes brjod cing mchod rol bya ste de yan chad kyis sngon 'gro'i rim pa rnams grub bo// ༈ de nas dngos gzhi dam tshig gi 'khor lo skyed pa la rnga rol bcas/ oṃ: skye med chos sku kun bzang mo: sogs nas/ dwangs ma thig ler 'dril ba las: yan gsungs/ de mtshams dpa' bo dpa' mo'i sgrub thabs las/ hūm̐: snying po 'khor lo pad 'dab bzhi'i: sogs nas/ bde chen gzi brjid 'bar ba bzhugs: bar de nas/ hūm̐: shar sgor rdo rje phra men dkar: sogs nas/ ātmā ko3 haṃ: bar/ de nas rnga (481) gzhag byin rlabs pa: hūm̐: lus ni ye shes mkha' 'gro'i sku: sogs lhug 'don dang sngags rgya bcas dril med/ dbang bskur ba/ hūm̐: thabs kyi spyod pa rmad po che: sogs/ shṝ ye hūm̐: rgya bcas dril med/ de nas ye shes kyi 'khor lo dgug pa ni/ rnga rol dbyangs bcas/ hūm̐ hūm̐/ bzhengs shig bla ma yi dam lha: sogs/ e āḥralli hriṃ hriṃ pheṃ pheṃ: bar rol mo ci rigs bcas/ de nas bzhugs gsol/ hūm̐: bde bar gshegs so dhā ki ni: sogs/ tiṣṭha lhan: bar rnga bcad nas/ phyag 'tshal ba/ ho: rdo rje khrag 'thung de bzhin gshegs= sogs/ pra tītstsha ho: bar lhug 'don/ de nas phyi mchod la/ hūm̐:

yan lag brgyad dang ldan pa yi: sogs dbyangs snyan par sngags rnams la phyag rgya bcas dril med/ shabta pra titstsha: swa hā: bar mchod rol/ de nas nang mchod la rnga dang bcas/ hūm̐: dbang po'i me tog la sogs pa: sogs dbyangs med/ rkang chen dung gi gling bu dang : zhes pa'i skabs thod rnga 'khrol zhing rkang gling 'bud pa tsam las sngags rnams la rgya sogs mi mdzad/ de nas gsang mchod ni/ hūm̐: he ru ka dpal khrag 'thung che: sogs nas/ pū dza ho: bar rnga gzhag de nas khyad par gyi mchod pa la dril bu dang*/ dbyangs bcas/ hūm̐: bkra shis mtshan ldan bhandha ru: sogs nas/ khā hi: bar/ de mtshams/ dbyings kyi (482)yum chen kun bzang mo: sogs nas/ khā hi: bar sbyar/ kā ya siddhi oṃ: sogs/ ho: bar de nas rnga dang bcas te/ hūm̐: lcang lor bcas pa'i bhandha ru: ma hā ba lingta kha khā hi: bar/ de nas che ba'i yon tan la bstod pa rnga bcas te/ hūm̐: bde gshegs kun gyi chos dbyings ye shes dbyings: sogs nas/ mkha' 'gro 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor lha la bstod: rnga rol ci rigs mthar gzhag de nas dzapra khang dbye ba/ bhrūm̐ bi shwa bi shūddhe hrīḥhūm̐: sogs/ me ri 'bar 'byor tshul du bzhugs: zhes gsal btab nas/ thugs rgyud bskul zhing ye shes 'bebs pa rdor dril dang dbyangs bcas/ hūm̐ hūm̐: mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i dkyil 'khor lha: sogs nas/ hriṃ hriṃ: bar mchod rol/ de nas bzlas dmigs/ mkha' 'gro ma rnams thugs ka ru: sogs/ gzi brjid 'bar bar gyur: ces lhug 'don dang*/ oṃ baṃ badzra bhā ra hi= sogs rtsa sngags stong rtsa'am ci rigs bzla/ sku dang gsung gi bzlas pa brgya phrag bdun tsam dang*/ thugs kyi bzlas pa dang*/ rigs bzhi'i mkha' 'gro la phreng skor ya zung re/ dpa' bo dpa' mo'i snying po dang*/ las dang dam tshig mkha' 'gro'i snying po/ oṃ sarba karma sa ma ya dhākī ni hūm̐: zhes pa rnams nyer gcig tsam re/ de nas dam tshig mkha' 'gro'i snying po la las bzhi'i gsham bu btags pa bdun re'am gsum re tsam/

bzlas dmigs rnams lhug 'don kho na bya/ de nas thugs kyi dgongs pa gsal 'debs ni/ oṃ baṃ badzra (483)ba ra hi= sogs lan gnyis gsum tsam dbyangs lta bu dal bus brjod cing gsal gdab pa dril 'khrol bzhin pas/ hūm̐: chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes de: sogs/ a a a: bar/ de nas/ hūm̐ hūm̐: zhes mang du brjod bzhin pas mchod rol bya/ de nas ā li kā li ye dharma gsum gsum gyis lhag chad kha bskang zhing brtan par bya/ mchod bstod ni rdor dril bcas/ hūm̐: dngos 'byor yid kyis rnam sprul pa'i: sogs/ pra tītstsha swa hā: mchod rol mthar/ ma hā pañtsa a mṛ ta rakta ba ling ta khā hi: hūm̐ḥ bde gshegs kun gyi sku gsung thugs yon tan: sogs/ lha la bstod: bar yig brgya gsum bcas/ thun mtshams gtor 'bul ni/ oṃ sa karma dha ki ni= sogs/ raṃ yaṃ khaṃ: gtor ma'i nyes skyon ma dag pa thams cad kun: sogs/ ha ho hrī: bar lhug 'don/ de nas rnga rol bcas/ hūm̐: dbyings nas sku bskyod bla ma yi dam lha: sogs/ sa ma ya dza dza: rol mo/ hūm̐ hrī: gtor snod bhandha chos kyi dbyings dang mnyam: sogs/ sngags rnams lan gsum re 'bul/ hūm̐: bla ma yi dam= sogs/ dngos grub ma lus stsol: bar ro/ dam can spyi gtor dang*/ na rag skong bshags sogs 'dir bya/ tshe g.yang zor sogs spro na thun mtshams gtor 'bul gong du stabs bde snyam/ dam can spyi gtor gyi chos srung gong du spyang bzhon mched gsum gtor 'bul gtong ba bcas so/ ༈ de nas rdo rje phag (484) mo'i mchod skong bya ba la/ oṃ baṃ badzra bhā ra hi= sogs rtsa sngags kyis rang nyid lhar gsal/ oṃ sa karma dha ki ni hūm̐ phaṭa: kyis bsang chu mchod rdzas rnams la 'thor zhing byin gyis rlob pa ni/ hūm̐: gsang ba mchog gi dkyil 'khor 'dir: sogs/ phyir dengs shig: drag sngags sum bha ni sogs rjod bzhin du rnga rol spyi rgyug mthar bzhag hūm̐: bdag nyid rdo rje khros ma yi:

sogs lhug 'don dang*/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐ bhrūṃ= sogs/ āḥhūm̐ḥ bar sngags lan gsum brlab/ rnga rol dbyangs bcas kyis bskul te/ hūm̐ hūm̐: bzhengs shig 'og min gsang chen rol pa nas: sogs/ a ralli ho: rol mo dang bcas spyan drangs te/ thun mong gi mchod pa sogs kyis bskang ba/ hūm̐: mkha' 'gro 'dus pa'i lha tshogs la: sogs rnga rdung nas rim par/ mahā dāe bi pra tītstsha swa hā: de nas rnga gzhag bshags pa 'bul ba/ ho: dgongs shig rdo rje phag mo yum: sogs lhug 'don dang*/ yig brgya bcas/ de nas tshogs dum liṅga gang rung la dgug gzhug spyi rgyug na mo:dkon mchog gsum dang chos skyong srung ma'i bden pas gnod byed dgra bgegs thams cad zhal zas tshogs kyi tha ma 'di la khug cig: ces brjod cing rnga rol mthar bsgral mchod bya'o// hūm̐ hūm̐: rdo rje khros ma dbyings nas bzhengs: sogs/ kha kha khā hi khā hi: bar rol mo spyi 'gro'i mthar gzhag de nas skong ba la/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐: skong ba'i gnas (485)mchog 'og min dur khrod zhing: sogs lhug 'don dang*/ sngags lan gsum gyis mthar/ rnga rol bcas/ hūm̐: chos dbyings ye shes pho brang nas: sogs nas/ mchog thun dngos grub ma lus stsal du gsol: bar yig brgya bcas sogs/ de yang spros pa rgyas pa'i skabs skong zhing 'gres byang so so re re bzhin sbyar/ bsdu na gtso bo la gcig rigs bzhi'i mkha' 'gro la gcig thugs 'khor brgyad la gcig gsung 'khor brgyad la gcig sku 'khor brgyad la gcig phra men brgyad la gcig mthar rtsa gsum spyi la gcig bcas sbyar bas chog gsungs/ de nas bye brag tu skong ba drug gi dang po rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i skong ba ni/ rtsa sngags tshar gcig gis rang nyid lhar gsal zhing*/ oṃ sa karma= sogs kyis bsang*/ swa bhā wa sa sbyang*/ thog mar bum par lha skyed pa ni/ hūm̐: rang byung ye shes phyag rgya'i 'phrul: bum pa lha yi gzhal med khang:

lhug 'don/ spyan drangs dbyer med gyur: bar spyan 'dren mchod bstod ni/ rdor dril bcas/ hūm̐ hūm̐: dbyings dang ye shes pho brang nas: sogs lhug 'don dang*/ e hya hiḥ bar dril bsil dang mchod bstod mthar/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho: dur khrod rol pa'i= sogs lhug 'don dang*/ bar mtshams sngags rnams sogs la dril bsil dang*/ sparshe pra tītstsha swa hā: bar mchod rol mthar/ ma hā pañtsa a mṛ ta rakta ba ling ta khā hī:(486) bstod pa/ hūm̐: bde gshegs kun gyi sku gsung thugs yon tan: sogs/ dkyil 'khor lha la bstod: ces spyan 'dren/ mchod bstod byang bu sbyar/ de nas/ oṃ badzra bha ra hī sogs/ hūm̐ hūm̐: bar lan gsum dal bur bzla/ de nas/ hūm̐: stong gsum 'jig rten thams cad kyi: sogs dril bsil bcas lhug 'don dal bus

mchog thun dngos grub ma lus stsaul: bar/ oṃ badzra bha ra hi kro dhi kā li ha ri ni sa a be sha ya dhā ka dhā ki ni sarba siddhi hūm̐ hūm̐: sngags 'di la 'byung bzhi so so'i sngags btags nas 'don pa kun la 'gres sbyar/ oṃ baṃ badzra ma mā ki dzwa la a mṛ ta pū dza sa ma ya ho: de gnyis sbrel ba lan bdun gyi mthar/ bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod 'khor dang bcas pa'i nad gdon sdig sgrib= sogs spel tshig mthar mchod rol bcas/ slar yang de 'dra tshar gnyis/ de nas lha tshogs rnams kyi gtsug gtor du phul bar gyur ces dang*/ gong gi sngags/ oṃ badzra bhā ra hi= sogs nas/ dhā ki ni ātma ko= sogs nas/ 'khyil bar gyur: ces dang*/ ji ltar bltams pa= sogs khrus tshig sngags bcas ci rigs dang*/ de dag sku la= sogs/ aḥ bar gyis 'thor 'thung sogs bya'o// de nas rin chen mkha' 'gro'i skong ba la/ (487)sum bha na ིsa bgegs bskrad cing*/ ma lus sems can= sogs/ 'dir ni rten dang= sogs/ ye dharma= su pra tiṣṭha= sogs kyis satstsha rab gnas bya/ yang rtsa sngags dang*/ oṃ sa karma= sogs dang*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐: stong pa'i ngang las skad cig gis: sogs lhug 'don dril bsil gyis/ sngags lan gsum gyis brlabs la 'bul ba ni/ hūm̐: stong gsum 'jig rten rab 'byams kyi: sra zhing brtan pa'i dngos po kun: sogs dang*/ oṃ badzra bhā ra hi kro dhī ka li ha ri ni sa a be sha ya dha ka dha ki ni sarba siddhi hūm̐ hūm̐: sngags 'di la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ laṃ badzra lo tsa na dharma kā ya sa ma ya pū dza ho: zhes btags pa sbrel te lan gsum gyis mthar/ lam̐ badzra sa ma ya shūddhe a āḥ bdag cag gi dam tshig nyams chag nyes ltung= sogs kyis mthar mchod rol bcas slar yang de 'dra tshar gnyis yang gong gi sngags/ oṃ badzra bha ra hi= sogs/ sarba siddhi hūm̐ hūm̐: zhes pa'i mthar/ oṃ badzra a yu ṣe swa hā: sogs sngags rnams re re bzhin so sor sbyar ba tshar re brjod mthar/

lha tshogs rnams mchog tu dgyes pa'i= sogs/ mi dgyes pa'i skyon dag par gyur: bar mkha' 'gro'i smre bshags dang mchod bstod rnams sbyar/ satstsha lag g.yas kyis spyi bor bzhag nas 'dzin bzhin tu/ mkha' 'gro ma'i dkyil 'khor= sogs yig brgya dang*/ de las bdud rtsi'i rgyun byung= sogs dang*/ oṃ laṃ lo tsa na (488)dharma kā ya badzra bha rā hi= sogs sngags lan gsum gyis mthar/ zhes brjod cing lha rang la bstim/ zhes brjod do/ de nas padma mkha' 'gro ma'i skong ba la/ me thab sreg rdzas sogs 'du byas nas/ rtsa sngags dang*/ sa karma dhā ki ni sa bsang chu 'thor/ oṃ āḥhūm̐: stong pa'i ngang las bsreg bya'i rdzas: sogs sngags lan gsum gyis brlabs te/ me thab la bsang chu bran nas/ oṃ sa karma dhī ki ni hūm̐ phaṭaḥ kyis bsang*/ swa bhā wa sa sbyang*/ hūm̐: skye med dbyings kyi thab khung du: sogs/ ye shes spyan drangs dbyer med gyur: bar spyan 'dren mchod bstod byang bu gong bzhin sbyar mthar/ oṃ dzña na dhī kī nī kro dhi kā li ha ri ni sa ā be sha ya sarba dhā ka dhā ki ni dzña na dzwa la siddhi hūm̐ hūm̐: sngags 'di lan gsum dal bus brjod/ de nas dgang blug mar khu bcas thogs la/ hūm̐: thabs dang shes rab zung 'jug pa'i: sogs dang*/ oṃ badzra bha ra hi kro dhi kā li ha ri ni sa ā be sha ya dhā ka dhā ki ni sarba siddhi hūm̐ hūm̐: zhes pa'i mthar/ ma hā dzña na a mṛ ta sarba pū dza ho: sbyar ba lan bdun tsam gyis mar khu yam shing 'bul/ de nas/ hūm̐: stong gsum 'jig rten rab 'byams kyi: sogs kyi mthar/ oṃ badzra bha ra hi= sogs/ dhā ka dhā ki ni sarba siddhi hūm̐ hūm̐: sngags 'di la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ paṃ paṇḍa ta ba si la hā dzña na a mṛ ta sarba pū dza ho: zhes btags te sbrel nas lan bdun gyi mthar/ rnal 'byor pa (489)bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa'i= sogs kyi mthar mchod rol/

slar yang de 'dra lan gnyis kyis sreg rdzas 'bul/ de nas/ oṃ badzra bhā rā hi kro dhi kā li ha ri ni sa= sogs kyi mthar/ sarba bhighnaṃ shāntiṃ ku ru swa hā: sogs kyi sngags rnams gong gi spyi 'gro'i sngags gsham du so sor sbyar ba tshar re brjod/ mkha' 'gro'i lha tshogs rnams= sogs/ lhun gyis grub par gyur: bar mchod bstod nongs bshags byang bu sbyar mthar/ sarba ḍāki ni= sogs/ dam tshig pa 'bar ba'i rnam par gyur: bar ro/ de nas las kyi mkha' 'gro'i rlung gi skong ba la/ spos rnams me thab 'jam par bsregs la/ rtsa sngags dang*/ sa karma= sogs kyis las bum gyi chus bran nas/ hūm̐: ye shes rang bzhin khyad par spos: sogs kyi sngags lan gsum dang*/ hūm̐: 'jig rten rab 'byams thams cad kyi: sogs kyi mthar/ oṃ badzra bha ra hi kro dhi kā li ha ri ni sa ā be sha ya dhā ka dhā ki ni sarba siddhi hūm̐ hūm̐: sngags 'di'i mthar/ oṃ āḥhūm̐: taṃ badzra ra ti ma hā su kha dhu pa pū dza sa ma ho: sbyar ba sbrel nas lan bdun gyi mthar/ rnal 'byor pa bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa'i dam tshig nyams chag= sogs kyi mthar/ mchod rol/ slar de 'dra lan gnyis sbyar/ de nas gong gi sngags gsham du/ sarba pā paṃ duḥkha shāntīṃ ku ru swa hā: sogs kyis sngags rnams gong gi spyi 'gro'i sngags kyi gsham bur so sor btags pa tshar re brjod mthar/ de ltar dgyes mchod phul bas= sogs dang*/ (490) mchod bstod nongs bshags byang bu sbyar/ lha rnams las 'od zer 'phros pa bdug pa'i sprin dang= sogs nas/ nus pa dang ldan par gyur: ces brjod cing spos kun la bdug go spros pa bsdus pa'i skabs 'byung bzhi'i skong ba bsgyur chog gsungs/ 'dir bshad pa ni sgrub mchod dkyus ma'i lugs yin gyi gzhan du rgyas par 'dod na'ang 'dis mtshon te gzhung gi dgongs pa ma nor bar dpyad nas spros pas chog de nas rdo rje phag mo mar me'i skong ba la/

rtsa sngags dang*/ las sngags/ sa karmā= sogs kyis las bum chus bran nas/ oṃ āḥhūm̐: stong gsum dbyings kyi kong bu ru: srid gsum= sogs/ sngags lan gsum gyis brlab/ hūm̐: snod bcud 'jig rten rab 'byams kyi: sogs lhug 'don dril bsil bcas/ oṃ badzra bha ra hi kro dhi ka li ha ri ni sa ā be sha ya dhā ka dhā ki nī sarba siddhi hūm̐ hūm̐: oṃ āḥhūm̐ baṃ badzra bha ra hi dzñā na a lo ke pū dza sa ma ye hoḥ sbrel ba lan bdun gyi mthar/ rnal 'byor pa bdag cag= sogs/ spel tshig mthar/ mchod rol/ yang de 'dra lan gnyis sbyar bas khyon nyer gcig go /yang gong gi spyi 'gro'i sngags gsham du/ sarba pā paṃ shāntiṃ ku ru swa hā: sogs kyis sngags rnams so sor sbyar ba tshar re'i mthar/ de kho na nyid kyi ye shes rgyas par gyur: ces dang*/ oṃ baṃ badzra= sogs nas/ ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bhyo hūm̐: lan gsum brjod/ de nas dril bsil bcas chu bo dal 'bebs (491) kyi dbyangs snyan pos/ bde chen 'khor lo'i kong bu ru: sogs nas/ pū dza hoḥ bar dang*/ bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro'i dkyil 'khor= sogs nas/ a a aḥ bar sngags lan gsum/ de nas mar me'i smon lam yang chu bo dal 'bebs kyi dbyangs snyan pos/ ho: dur khrod gsang chen mkha' 'gro'i dkyil 'khor du: sogs nas/ bde chen sku gsung thugs su 'grub par shog: bar ro/ gzhung gi dgongs pa ltar na 'dir 'khrugs skong mdos skong sbyar dgos pa 'dra/ bla mas ni gong gi skong chen mtha' 'byung bzhi'i skong ba'i dbur sleb mtshams der sbyar bar mdzad/ gang ltar yang*/ sngags drug phyag drug dang*/ bden stobs/ na mo/ bdag gi bsam pa'i stobs dag dang*/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i= chos kyi dbyings= snang srid ma mo'i mgron la 'dod yon tshogs// thogs pa med pa 'byung gyur cig /ces brjod nas rnga rol bcas/ 'khrugs skong mthar mdos skong yang sbyar/

'khrugs skong gong du song na/ mar me'i smon lam de ma thag dang*/ 'khrugs skong 'dir sbyar na de'i mthar mkha' 'gro'i smre bshags chu bo dal 'bebs kyi dbyangs snyan pos bya/ dril bu dkrol bar mi mdzad/ de nas spros med don gyi skong bshags/ rdor dril dang dbyangs bcas/ hūm̐: dngos po stong nyid chos sku'i klong du bskang: sogs nas/ sa ma ya shūddhe a a aḥ bar ro/ de nas tshogs tshar gsum gtong ba'i tshe tshogs bsdus nang gi lhag ma/ oṃ āḥ(492)hūm̐ pañtsa a mṛ ta hūm̐ hrīḥṭhā: sogs nas/ ba ling ta khā hi: rol mo bcas smon lam bya ba/ ho: bdag cag rdo rje'i rnal 'byor= sogs nas/ 'grub par shog: des tshogs rgyas pa tshar gcig song*/ tshogs tshar re'i mtshams sgrol ma tshar re gsung rgyu'i phyag len mdzad pas 'dir yang sgrol ma tshar gcig gtang zhing rjes ma la'ang gtang ngo// ༈ de nas tshogs bsdus btang na yang rtsa sngags/ oṃ sa karma dhā ki ni hūm̐ phaṭaḥ kyis bsang*/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ hūm̐: bdag nyid rdo rje khros ma yi: sogs lhug 'don dang*/ sngags lan gsum grub na legs/ de nas rnga rol bcas/ hūm̐ hūm̐: bzhengs shig 'og min dur khrod gnas yul nas: sogs/ e a ralli ho: rnga rol dang*/ hūm̐: mkha' 'gro 'dus pa'i lha tshogs la: sogs nas/ ma hā ga ṇa tsakra pū dza khā hi: bar/ rnga rol gzhag ho: dgongs shig rdo rje phag mo yum: sogs lhug 'don/ yig brgya yan/ de nas tshogs 'gugs spyi rgyug dang*/ e yaṃ dzwa la raṃ= sogs/ rnga rol bcas/ sarba ga ṇa tsakra pū dza kha kha khā hi khā hi: bar gyis tshogs bsgral bstab bya/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ badzra dzñā na kā ma gu ṇa spha ra ṇa khaṃ/ gsum mam gcig hūm̐ hrī: bskang ngo gsol lo mchod do thugs dam bskang: sogs mthar yig brgya bcas/ lhag ma tshogs smon lam bcas btang bas tshogs bsdus tshar gcig ste/ slar tshogs bsdus (493) 'dir lan gcig bskyar ba'o/ yang na shin tu bsdus pa/

ram̐ yam̐ kham̐: tshogs kyi nyes skyon ma dag thams cad kun: sogs/ ha ho hrīḥ bar lhug 'don/ de nas rnga rol mchod rol ci rigs kyis/ hūm̐: dbyings nas skur skyod bla ma yi dam lha: sogs/ dza dza: bar/ rol mo dang*/ hūm̐ hrī: tshogs snod bhandha chos kyi dbyings dang mnyam: sogs/ ga ṇa tsakra pū dza kha kha khā hi khā hi: bar/ skong ba tshogs skong 'bring po'i skang bsdus de btang na 'thus shing tshogs skong de tsam las mi gtong na 'di mtshams rol mo bcas/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ bla ma rgya mtsho tshogs la rol: sogs kyis bzed zhal nang gi tshogs phud rnams phyi rol du gtsang sar mchod/ bsam pa lhun grub dbu nas bzung*/ las can 'gro ba'i don du gter 'don na: zhes pa'i mgo bar 'don/ de mtshams bzhag nas las kyi rdo rjes phyag dang bcas/ brda dang brda yi 'bul len gyis rdo rje rgyal po nas bzung rim par 'dus pa rnams la tshogs kyi dga' ston bstabs nas/ hrī: bdag lus phung khams skye mched= sogs nang gi tshogs mchod kyis rol lo/ de nas/ las can 'gro ba'i don du gter 'don na: sogs bsam lhun mtha' bar dang*/ gzhan yang bsam pa myur 'grub sogs ci rigs mthar lhag ma ni/ mchod skong gzhung gi oṃ āḥhūm̐: sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta hūm̐ ha ho hrī: rnga rol gcad/ (494)hūm̐ hūm̐: bcom ldan rdo rje phag mo ni: sogs/ ba ling ta khā hi: bar/ de nas phud lhag dang*/ rnal 'byor pa'i lhag ma bsres par zhal chab bran nas/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ pañtsa a mṛ ta hūm̐ hrīḥṭhā: dang*/ sarba karma= sogs/ hrīṃ hrīṃ pheṃ pheṃ/ rnga rol ci rigs bcas/ hūm̐: dang po phud kyis lha tshogs mchod: sogs nas/ ma ma ba ling ta khā hi: bar/ rnga rol ci rigs mthar/ hoḥ bdag cag rdo rje'i rnal 'byor mched lcam gyi: sogs nas/ grol bar shog: rdo rje'i glu e ma ki ri= sogs kyang 'dir bya'o/ de nas dam can spyi gtor nas gtor 'bul/ na mo/ rig 'dzin rtsa brgyud

sogs dang*/ khā hiḥ gtor 'bul dang*/ phrin las bcol/ hūm̐:chos kyi dbyings nas= sogs dang*/ bzod gsol/ rten bzhugs/ bsngo smon bkra shis bya/ de nas gzhung gi brtan ma skyong ba ni/ oṃ āḥhūm̐: ratna ba ling ta spha ra ṇa khaṃ: hūm̐: tshogs dang bka' yi 'khor los sgyur: sogs nas/ ba ling ta khāhiḥ rnga rol ci rigs bcas/ gtor ma phyi rol du phul nas gtor gzhong sbubs pa'i steng rdo rje gzhag gtor 'gugs spyi rgyug mthar/ hūm̐: mkha' 'gro 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor du: sogs nas/ e laṃ st+waṃ bha ya nan/ bros mnan pa'i mthar/ gtor gzhong kha yar bstan pa'i nang 'brus bkang la/ ye dharma brjod/ de nas nyin dang po rnams la mchod bstod nongs bshags/ rten bzhugs bsdu ldang*/ bsngo smon/ shis brjod bcas mthar chags su bya/ (495) sgrub mchod tshar ba'i nub mo bro mnan zin pa dang*/ rdo rje phag mo'i phrin las kyi mthar rjes kyi rim pa'i thog mar dngos grub blang ba la/ bhandha bzang po chang gis bkang bar a mṛ ta btab pa dang*/ gzhan yang dngos grub kyi rdzas zan dang*/ 'khur ba/ sha dum/ mthud/ bu ram sogs dum bur gtubs la bzhag nas/ mkha' 'gro ma'i dkyil 'khor pa rnams= sogs/ rgya mtsho chen po 'khyil bar gyur: bar/ oṃ āḥhūm̐: sogs sngags mang du bzlas mthar/ gzhung du thod pa kho na las ma gsungs kyang*/ rdo rje phag mo'i sku dang*/ gsung bdud rtsi dang*/ thugs sin dhu ra'i me long*/ sgrub gtor sogs dngos grub tu len par mdzad pas de bzhin nam/ gang ltar yang*/ rdo dril bcas/ hūm̐: rdo rje'i phag mo'i lha tshogs rnams: sogs nas/ mchog thun dngos grub ma lus stsol: rtsa sngags mthar/ kā ya wākka tsitta dzñā na= sogs btang nas sbrel bar bzla bzhin sku rten spyi ltar gzhag gsung rten mgrin par gtugs shing bdud rtsi myang*/ thugs rten snying gar gtugs shing sin dhu ras byug gtor ma gnas gsum du gtugs shing gtor zan sogs dngos grub tu rol/

bdud rtsi rol pas= sogs/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha dang skal ba mnyam par gyur: bar ro/ de nas mchod kha gso zhing gtang raka mchod bstod bzod gsol mthar/ bsdu ldang ni/ hūm̐ hūm̐: snod bcud gzhal yas= sogs dang*/ lhug 'don/ bsngo smon/ ho: dge )496)ba 'di dang = sogs lhug 'don dang*/ mthar ye dharma= brjod cing rdor dril dbyangs bcas bkra shis brjod pa ni/ oṃ: byin rlabs gzi brjid dpal du 'bar: sogs dang*/ gzhan yang bkra shis pa'i tshigs bcad ci rigs mthar rol mo bcas so/ slar yang bzang po spyod pa'i smon lam sogs kyis mtha' brgyan par bya'o// ces pa'ang karma 'jam pa'i rdo rje'i phrin las kyi rnam rol yang srid rin po che'i bka' bstsal spyi bor blangs nas/ tshul 'dir mos pas 'jug pa 'ga' la'ang phan par 'gyur ram snyam nas bris pa nyes 'gal bshags shing dge bas gzhan la phan pa rgya chen 'byung bar gyur cig/ dge'o//
